title: Shared and inherited controls

kcs.statement: Patch management, configuration management, and awareness and training are shared controls: AWS performs them for its infrastructure and the customer performs them for its own guest systems, applications and staff.
Physical and environmental controls are inherited controls: the customer relies entirely on AWS for them and can cite AWS's audits of them in its own compliance work.

problem_ideas: 'Which is a shared control?' options: physical security, patch management, data classification, hypervisor updates
Who trains AWS data center staff, and who trains the customer's developers?
